border px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer select-none shadow-sm backdrop-blur-sm border-border/60 bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="hooks">Hooks<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Hook 用来在特定事件时机自动执行动作——在会话开始时注入团队约束、在工具调用前做安全检查、在模型准备结束时校验产出。适合希望在会话、模型请求、工具调用和停止阶段自动执行检查、补充上下文或实施策略的插件开发者与项目维护者。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Hook 本质上是一个本地子进程协议：ZCode 向进程的 stdin 写入一行 JSON，进程通过退出码和 stdout JSON 返回结果。Hook 不会获得可直接调用 ZCode 模型的内部对象。</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">安全提示</strong>：Hook 会执行本地代码。启用第三方插件前请审查其来源、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code> 和脚本。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">这一页怎么读</strong>：只想在设置页里配几条 Hook，看 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#events">执行顺序与事件</a>、<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#config-sources">配置来源</a> 和 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#settings-page">在设置页创建和维护 Hook</a> 就够了。从 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#quickstart">快速上手</a> 开始是面向开发者的部分——输入输出契约、退出码和插件打包，不打算自己写脚本可以直接跳过。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="events">执行顺序与事件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">新 session → SessionStart
用户提交 → UserPromptSubmit → 主模型
主模型请求工具 → PreToolUse → 需要确认时 PermissionRequest → 执行工具
工具成功 → PostToolUse；工具失败 → PostToolUseFailure
主模型准备结束 → Stop → 结束，或注入反馈后继续主模型
</code></pre>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">事件</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">matcher</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">主要用途与效果</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">SessionStart</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">匹配 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">source</code>，常见值为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">startup</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">clear</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">compact</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">首轮模型请求前初始化环境、注入项目约束或操作说明</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">UserPromptSubmit</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">不参与过滤，即使填写也会执行</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">模型调用前补充上下文，或阻断本次用户请求；不能改写原始 prompt</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PreToolUse</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">匹配工具名</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">允许、询问或拒绝工具；可完整替换工具输入，替换后会重新校验 schema</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PermissionRequest</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">匹配工具名</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">只在权限结果需要询问时触发；可允许、拒绝、更新输入或权限规则</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PostToolUse</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">匹配工具名</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">工具成功后追加模型可见上下文；不能替换工具输出</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PostToolUseFailure</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">匹配工具名</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">工具失败后追加恢复建议、诊断或重试约束</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Stop</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">不参与过滤，即使填写也会执行</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">模型准备结束时检查结果；返回 block 可让现有主模型循环继续，最多连续 3 次</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="config-sources">配置来源<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">来源</th><th class="border-b px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">当前用户的所有工作区</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">必须在该文件中设置 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks.enabled: true</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">插件 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">随插件安装和分发</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">标准位置自动发现，随插件启停；不需要再在 manifest 中重复声明同一文件</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm <blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目级 Hook 当前不会执行。</strong> 出于安全策略，写在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;workspace&gt;/.zcode/config.json</code> 或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;workspace&gt;/zcode.json</code> 里的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks</code> 配置在当前版本会被整体忽略（无论 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks.enabled</code> 是否为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">true</code>，日志中记为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">config_project_hooks_ignored</code>），设置页也已隐藏工作区作用域的配置入口。需要团队共享的 Hook，请改用<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">插件</strong>分发（随插件安装、可随仓库版本管理），或让成员各自配置用户级 Hook。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">执行顺序是 user Hook → 已启用插件 Hook。同一来源内按数组顺序执行。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">每个 session 启动时会捕获一份 Hook 配置快照。修改文件、在设置页保存或启停插件后，请<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建 session</strong> 验证；已经启动的 session 不保证热更新。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">用户配置示例：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;hooks&quot;: {
    &quot;enabled&quot;: true,
    &quot;timeoutMs&quot;: 60000,
    &quot;maxOutputBytes&quot;: 32768,
    &quot;events&quot;: {
      &quot;PreToolUse&quot;: [
        {
          &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;Write|Edit&quot;,
          &quot;hooks&quot;: [
            {
              &quot;type&quot;: &quot;process&quot;,
              &quot;command&quot;: &quot;node&quot;,
              &quot;args&quot;: [&quot;scripts/check-write.mjs&quot;],
              &quot;enabled&quot;: true,
              &quot;timeoutMs&quot;: 10000
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="quickstart">快速上手：第一个插件 Hook<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">下面的插件在新 session 启动时给模型补充一条团队约束。示例依赖系统 PATH 中可用的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">node</code>。</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">context-guard/
├── .zcode-plugin/
│   └── plugin.json
└── hooks/
    ├── hooks.json
    └── context.mjs
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">plugin.json</code>（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code> 是标准位置会自动加载，manifest 不必再写 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks</code> 字段）：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;name&quot;: &quot;context-guard&quot;,
  &quot;version&quot;: &quot;0.1.0&quot;,
  &quot;description&quot;: &quot;在会话开始时注入团队开发约束&quot;
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code>：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Context Guard hooks&quot;,
  &quot;hooks&quot;: {
    &quot;SessionStart&quot;: [
      {
        &quot;matcher&quot;: &quot;startup|clear|compact&quot;,
        &quot;hooks&quot;: [
          {
            &quot;type&quot;: &quot;process&quot;,
            &quot;command&quot;: &quot;node&quot;,
            &quot;args&quot;: [&quot;${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/context.mjs&quot;],
            &quot;timeoutMs&quot;: 5000
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/context.mjs</code>：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-javascript">let raw = &quot;&quot;;
process.stdin.setEncoding(&quot;utf8&quot;);
for await (const chunk of process.stdin) raw += chunk;

const input = JSON.parse(raw);
process.stderr.write(&quot;[context-guard] &quot; + input.hook_event_name + &quot;\n&quot;);
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({
  hookSpecificOutput: {
    hookEventName: input.hook_event_name,
    additionalContext: &quot;本项目提交前必须运行类型检查和受影响测试。&quot;
  }
}));
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">验证步骤：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; 插件</strong> 中点右上角 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建 -&gt; 添加插件市场</strong> 加入本地来源，安装并启用插件。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; Hooks</strong> 确认插件 Hook 以只读条目出现，事件、matcher、命令和来源路径正确。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">新建 session 并发起请求；首轮模型应能看到注入的团队约束。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">调试时把日志写到 stderr，stdout 只输出协议结果，避免诊断文字破坏 JSON。</li>
</ol>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="executors">执行器、超时与 matcher<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">类型</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">语义</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">建议</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">process</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">command + args[]</code>，直接按 argv 执行，不经过 shell；只支持同步</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">参数边界清楚，跨平台更稳定，优先用于 Node、Python 或二进制脚本</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">command</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">把完整字符串交给系统 shell；可设置 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">shell</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">async</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">timeout</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">适合兼容现有 Claude Marketplace 插件；注意 Windows、macOS、Linux 的 shell 和引用差异</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">timeoutMs</code> 单位是毫秒；兼容字段 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">timeout</code> 单位是秒。两者同时存在时优先 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">timeoutMs</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">根级默认超时是 60000 ms，默认 stdout 上限是 32768 bytes。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">单条 Hook 可写 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">enabled: false</code>；runtime 会真正跳过，不只是界面置灰。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">command</code> 的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">async: true</code> 是 fire-and-forget：当前事件立即继续，后台 stdout 不能阻断、改输入或注入上下文；超时、取消、完成和失败仍记录生命周期。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">statusMessage</code> 当前会保存并在设置页展示，但还不是运行时的实时状态提示。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">matcher 规则</strong>：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">缺省、空字符串或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">*</code>：匹配全部。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">只含字母、数字、下划线和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">|</code>：按精确名称列表匹配，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Write|Edit</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">包含其他字符：按 JavaScript 正则处理；非法正则不执行该 matcher，并产生诊断。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">工具事件匹配实际工具名，并兼容 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Agent</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Task</code> alias。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">SessionStart</code> 匹配 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">source</code>；<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">UserPromptSubmit</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Stop</code> 不使用 matcher 过滤。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="stdin">stdin 输入契约<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 向每个 Hook 写入「一行 JSON + 换行」。同一份输入同时保留 ZCode camelCase 字段与 Claude Code snake_case alias，旧插件可以继续读取 snake_case。</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;session_id&quot;: &quot;session-123&quot;,
  &quot;transcript_path&quot;: &quot;/tmp/zcode-hook/transcript.jsonl&quot;,
  &quot;cwd&quot;: &quot;/workspace/demo&quot;,
  &quot;permission_mode&quot;: &quot;default&quot;,
  &quot;hook_event_name&quot;: &quot;PreToolUse&quot;,
  &quot;tool_name&quot;: &quot;Write&quot;,
  &quot;tool_input&quot;: {
    &quot;file_path&quot;: &quot;src/index.ts&quot;,
    &quot;content&quot;: &quot;...&quot;
  },
  &quot;tool_use_id&quot;: &quot;tool-123&quot;
}
</code></pre>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">事件</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">重点字段</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">SessionStart</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">source</code>，可选 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">agent_type</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">model</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">UserPromptSubmit</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">prompt</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PreToolUse</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tool_name</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tool_input</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tool_use_id</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PermissionRequest</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tool_name</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tool_input</code>，有真实数据时包含 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">permission_suggestions</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PostToolUse</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">完整结构化 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tool_response</code>，以及工具名、输入和调用 ID</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">PostToolUseFailure</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">字符串 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">error</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">is_interrupt</code>，以及工具字段</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Stop</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">stop_hook_active</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">last_assistant_message</code></td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">transcript_path</code> 指向本次 Hook 可读的临时 JSONL 文件。ZCode 会在 Hook 完成后清理临时目录，不要把它当作长期存储；插件持久化数据请写入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCODE_PLUGIN_DATA</code>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="stdout">stdout、退出码与常用返回值<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">stdout 为空表示成功且无附加效果；非 JSON stdout 只作为诊断，不进入模型上下文。只有去除前导空白后以 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{</code> 开头的合法 JSON 才按协议解析。未知字段会忽略，已知字段类型错误或事件名不符会让当前 Hook 可恢复失败，不影响后续 Hook。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">注入上下文（推荐使用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hookSpecificOutput</code>，事件归属最清楚；也兼容顶层 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">additionalContext</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">additional_context</code>）：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;hookSpecificOutput&quot;: {
    &quot;hookEventName&quot;: &quot;SessionStart&quot;,
    &quot;additionalContext&quot;: &quot;只修改与当前任务相关的文件。&quot;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="pretooluse-output">PreToolUse：修改或拒绝工具调用<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;hookSpecificOutput&quot;: {
    &quot;hookEventName&quot;: &quot;PreToolUse&quot;,
    &quot;permissionDecision&quot;: &quot;allow&quot;,
    &quot;permissionDecisionReason&quot;: &quot;已重定向到允许目录&quot;,
    &quot;updatedInput&quot;: {
      &quot;file_path&quot;: &quot;generated/index.ts&quot;,
      &quot;content&quot;: &quot;...&quot;
    },
    &quot;additionalContext&quot;: &quot;文件已被重定向到 generated 目录。&quot;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">updatedInput</code> 是完整替代对象，不是局部 patch；ZCode 会用工具 schema 重新校验。拒绝时返回 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">permissionDecision: &quot;deny&quot;</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">permissionDecisionReason</code>。多个 Hook 聚合时，deny 优先于 ask，ask 优先于 allow。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="permissionrequest-output">PermissionRequest：自动允许或拒绝权限询问<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;hookSpecificOutput&quot;: {
    &quot;hookEventName&quot;: &quot;PermissionRequest&quot;,
    &quot;decision&quot;: {
      &quot;behavior&quot;: &quot;deny&quot;,
      &quot;message&quot;: &quot;生产目录只能在发布流程中修改&quot;
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">允许时把 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">behavior</code> 改为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">allow</code>，并可在 decision 中返回 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">updatedInput</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">updatedPermissions</code>；历史字段 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">permissionUpdates</code> 也兼容。显式 deny 规则、Plan 模式写入禁令和工具硬限制不能被 Hook allow 绕过。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="userpromptsubmit-output">UserPromptSubmit：阻断本次模型请求<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;continue&quot;: false,
  &quot;reason&quot;: &quot;请先提供工单号&quot;,
  &quot;hookSpecificOutput&quot;: {
    &quot;hookEventName&quot;: &quot;UserPromptSubmit&quot;,
    &quot;additionalContext&quot;: &quot;该请求被团队策略阻断。&quot;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="stop-output">Stop：让主模型继续一轮<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;decision&quot;: &quot;block&quot;,
  &quot;reason&quot;: &quot;还没有给出测试命令和结果，请补齐后再结束。&quot;
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">decision: &quot;block&quot;</code> 需要带 reason 或 additionalContext 才会续跑。为兼容旧 ZCode 配置，也接受 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">continue: true</code> 且带 additionalContext。连续续跑达到 3 次后会强制结束，防止无限循环。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="exit-codes">退出码<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">退出码</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">含义</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">0</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">成功，解析 stdout</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">2</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">阻断快捷方式；在可阻断事件中产生 block / deny，在 Stop 中产生继续一轮的反馈</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">其他非零</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">当前 Hook 可恢复失败，记录诊断，turn 不会因此整体崩溃</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="plugin-hooks">插件发现、变量与安全边界<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">manifest 查找优先级：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode-plugin/plugin.json</code> → <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.claude-plugin/plugin.json</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">标准 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks/hooks.json</code> 自动加载；manifest 的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks</code> 还支持相对 JSON 路径、inline 对象或二者数组。不要让 manifest 再指向同一个标准文件，否则会记录重复诊断并跳过重复项。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">插件进程可读取 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCODE_PLUGIN_DATA</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCODE_PLUGIN_ID</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCODE_PLUGIN_NAME</code>；兼容变量 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA</code> 也会注入。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">命令、参数里的插件路径变量会在执行前替换。长期数据写入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCODE_PLUGIN_DATA</code>，不要写回安装目录。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">插件 Hook 在设置页只读，启停跟随插件本身。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="settings-page">在设置页创建和维护 Hook<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; Hooks</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">选择 user 或 workspace scope，新增事件、执行类型、matcher、命令 / 参数、超时、async 和状态文案。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">已有 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> Hook 支持查看、编辑、删除和单条启停。编辑时不能直接改变 scope；需要删除后在目标 scope 重建。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Hook 不生效时先确认：Hook 是否写在了项目级配置里（当前版本不执行，见<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="#config-sources">配置来源</a>）、配置来源里 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hooks.enabled</code> 是否为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">true</code>、插件是否处于启用状态，然后<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建一个 session</strong>——Hook 配置在 session 启动时形成快照，修改配置或启停插件不会影响已经启动的 session。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">仍有问题时可以查日志：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/cli/log/zcode-&lt;日期&gt;.jsonl</code> 中会记录 Hook 的执行失败（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">hook.run.failed</code>，含来源和耗时）与被忽略的项目级配置（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">config_project_hooks_ignored</code>）。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
